source_passage: Online forex/CFD brokerage (regulated financial services) with a textbook supply-chain breach: attackers stole an external service provider's credentials via malware and used them to access Pepperstone's CRM, extracting client PII (names, email, phone, address, DOB) in 2020. Trading/financial systems were segregated and not compromised. Persistent brand-impersonation/phishing (clone sites, FCA clone warning) keeps cyber risk live. The 2020 vendor-driven breach is a direct selling point for supply-chain cyber cover; dated incident and segregated financial systems hold it at Medium. 2020 breach via compromised third-party vendor credentials → CRM access; client PII (name/email/phone/address/DOB) extracted; trading systems segregated and unaffected; regulators and clients notified FCA (UK) clone-firm warning over 'Pepperforeign' impersonating the authorised brand (2021) Ongoing brand-impersonation/phishing: CEO says scam sites/fake accounts taken down 'almost daily'; 100+ defensive domains registered (2025) Parent/majority owner: Lock's FX Group Holdings (~60%); principals Fiona Lock, CEO Tamas Szabo, Andrew Defina Former PE owner: CHAMP Private Equity (exited 2018) Trading-platform suppliers: MetaQuotes (MT4/MT5), Spotware Systems (cTrader), TradingView Sponsorship: Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
